name: Lassen Volcanic National Park
policyReason: Pets are allowed in developed areas: campgrounds, picnic areas, paved roads and parking areas.
summary: Pets are allowed in developed areas: campgrounds, picnic areas, paved roads and parking areas.

excerpts.quote: Pets are not permitted on any hiking trail, in the park backcountry (including snow-covered roads or trails), in any body of water, or inside visitor centers or other park facilities.

dogRules.text: No trails, backcountry, water or buildings.
Unplowed roads with snow are off limits.
